meta.name: tdd
meta.description: Test-driven development. Use when the user wants to build features or fix bugs test-first, mentions "red-green-refactor", or wants integration tests.

copy.tagline: 用测试驱动的方式构建功能或修复缺陷
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果习惯先写测试再写代码，或需要提升代码质量
copy.tagline_en: Build features or fix bugs test-first
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you prefer writing tests before code or need to improve code quality

howto.what: Claude 会引导你按照红-绿-重构循环进行测试驱动开发：先写一个会失败的测试，再写刚好能通过的代码，然后重构。它会帮你写出关注公共接口、不依赖内部实现的测试，并避免常见反模式。
howto.when: 当你提到“测试驱动开发”、“红-绿-重构”或想要先写测试再写功能/修复 bug 时触发。

say.text: 我想用 TDD 方式添加一个用户注册功能。
say.note: Claude 会引导你从写一个失败测试开始。

say.text: 帮我修复这个 bug，但先写测试。
say.note: Claude 会先让你写一个暴露 bug 的测试。

say.text: 我们来做红-绿-重构循环。
say.note: Claude 会按 TDD 循环步骤指导你。

howto.what_en: Claude guides you through the red-green-refactor cycle: write a failing test, then just enough code to pass, then refactor. It helps you write tests that focus on public interfaces, avoid implementation coupling, and steer clear of common anti-patterns.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "test-driven development", "red-green-refactor", or want to write tests before implementing features or fixing bugs.

say_en.text: I want to add a user registration feature using TDD.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you to start with a failing test.

say_en.text: Help me fix this bug, but write the test first.
say_en.note: Claude will have you write a test that exposes the bug first.
Claude will walk you through each step of the TDD cycle.
